subject: stan_lmer and dense data - CP parametrization available?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: stan_lmer and dense data - CP parametrization available?
parts:
Hi!

I am suspecting that a case where I would like to fit with stan_lmer a CP parametrization could help to speedup things. Is this possible to try out quickly with some magic switch in rstanarm?

The model has a 3-level nested random effects structure and lots of data is available; lmer runs OK, but stan_lmer seems to give me better variance estimates.

Thanks!

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: stan_lmer and dense data - CP parametrization available?
parts:
On Tuesday, April 18, 2017 at 4:36:13 AM UTC-4, Sebastian Weber wrote:
I am suspecting that a case where I would like to fit with stan_lmer a CP parametrization could help to speedup things. Is this possible to try out quickly with some magic switch in rstanarm?
No; lmer() and thus stan_lmer() have a non-centered parameterization hard-coded.
